necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. This diagnostic procedure is essential for guiding further treatment decisions given the patient's complex cardiac history.
